title: Blockscape Odyssey
description: This modpack puts allot of new things to discover, with world gen mods, new dimensions and more.
body:
![Blockscape Odyssey logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad6723843b3a08c7028076410ce956d0fa837e17.png)


### Short description

A cozy exploration-focused modpack that expands biomes, adds new dimensions, and invites relaxed adventures and discovery.


![What is Blockscape Odyssey?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62e8562558b72d009a850717a1a4ce9c6ad0e18f.png)

Blockscape Odyssey is a cozy modpack built for slow mornings and long walks through curious worlds. It adds a whole lot more to explore from new biomes and hidden pockets of nature to extra dimensions that reward the curious. Expect gentle progression, lovely oddities, and mods that make the world feel warmer and more lived-in.

With world-generation mods like *Oh The Biomes We’ve Gone* and dreamy dimensions like *The Aether*, every trip outside your door can turn into a small adventure. There’s new armor and gear, little surprises around the map, and plenty of calm corners to settle in and build a home.


![The history of Blockscape Odyssey.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a50d23a3f6acf3bc9410bdf5c02dd43555f5290_0.webp)

This started out as a tiny project called **“Vanilla Refresh”** a simple idea: make default Minecraft feel a bit fresher. It later became **“Beyond Blocks”** for a while, but the early versions were rough: unstable and slow.

I eventually decided to rebuild everything from the ground up: better mods, cleaner setup, and a focus on performance and charm. The result is **Blockscape Odyssey** the same cozy spirit, but polished and much more enjoyable to explore.


Find out where the mod and everything started on [curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/blockscapeodyssey)!
